title: Symmetry and positive-coordinate count
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\beta$ be any type, and let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\beta$. The function is invariant under every permutation of its input coordinates if and only if $f(x)=f(y)$ whenever $x$ and $y$ have the same number of coordinates equal to $+1$.
